layer.description: The gap between the value and its reference, shaded. Filtered to periods that have a value: an area whose y is null still closes one step past the last point, which draws a block into the following period that looks like data.
The reference, as a step. A level held for a period is not a trajectory between periods, and a one-period override drawn linearly looks like a ramp.
The value. Nulls break the line rather than drawing it to zero.
Flagged periods, the only strong colour on the row. The flag is computed by the model, never as a > b in the spec — above the reference is good news on an income row.
